Alex / Laura —

I pulled the availability windows for BrightScope for the April billing period and ran the SLA calculation. Notes below and I attached the detailed workbook (service-credit-calculation-brightscope.xlsx).

Summary of measured downtime (UTC):
- Primary incident window: 2026-04-26 15:07:00 - 2026-04-26 17:23:00 (2 hours 16 minutes)
- Follow-up degraded tail: 2026-04-26 18:05:00 - 2026-04-26 18:57:00 (52 minutes)
- Total measured downtime in billing period: 3 hours 8 minutes = 188 minutes

SLA details (per contract HS-0004729):
- Monthly uptime objective (MUO): 99.9%
- Measurement: rolling monthly calendar (UTC)
- Remedy: Service credit equal to (downtime_minutes / total_minutes_in_month) * monthly_commit, capped at 50% of monthly commit

Calculation (April = 30 days = 43,200 minutes):
- Impact fraction = 188 / 43,200 = 0.0043519 (~0.435%)
- BrightScope monthly committed spend (per contract) = $2,850,000 (annualized/12 for committed monthly) — see HS deal record for confirmation
- Calculated credit = 0.0043519 * $2,850,000 = $12,405.81
- Cap check (50% cap) = $1,425,000 — calculated credit well below cap

Recommendation: issue a credit for $12,405.81. I created a draft credit memo (credit-memo-BrightScope-0429.pdf) and a supporting spreadsheet. For routing: finance needs a short approval (Laura) and a customer acceptance signature on the credit agreement or an email confirming acceptance; we typically apply credits to the next invoice unless the customer requests a refund.

Attachments: service-credit-calculation-brightscope.xlsx (Excel), credit-memo-BrightScope-0429.pdf (PDF)

Let me know if you want me to drop these into DocuSign for signature or if Alex will coordinate with the customer.
